assignments.description: Guard path. A revenue figure is missing or zero, so no disparity can be computed — null the percent and clear the flag rather than leaving a stale value from a previous calculation. The cleared flag asserts nothing: it is the absence of a disparity finding, not a finding that the file is clean.
assignments.name: Clear_Disparity
assignments.label: Clear Disparity

assignments.description: Writes the computed disparity to stored fields. TODO Component 2b: publish disparity to audit log via Platform Event — hook in here, alongside the Equifax callout that publishes the access log.
assignments.name: Set_Disparity
assignments.label: Set Disparity

constants.description: Overstatement threshold, in percent, at or above which the disparity flag is raised. Single tunable knob for this control. A production build would externalise this to Custom Metadata so it can be changed per credit policy without editing the flow.
constants.name: DISPARITY_THRESHOLD_PERCENT

decisions.description: Completeness and divide-by-zero guard. Both revenue figures must be present before any arithmetic: the formula divides by verified revenue, and a missing declared figure is not a declared zero. A record failing this gets no disparity value at all rather than a fabricated one — declining to answer, not asserting the applicant is clean. The grounding confidence flow is the control that reports the missing input.
decisions.name: Revenue_Inputs_Usable
decisions.label: Revenue Inputs Usable?

Flow.description: Deterministic credit control: computes the signed declared-vs-verified revenue disparity and raises the overstatement flag. Stored, not a formula field — a formula recalculates on every read, leaving no auditable value as at assessment time. Runs before save, so it writes to the same record with no DML. TODO Component 2b: publish disparity to audit log via Platform Event.

formulas.description: Signed disparity as a percentage of verified revenue. Positive means the applicant overstated. Rounded to 2dp to match the field scale. Only evaluated on the guarded path, so both figures are present and non-zero and the divisor is never null or zero. Deliberately no BLANKVALUE on the declared figure: coercing a missing declaration to zero produced a spurious -100% that read as a clean file.
formulas.name: fmlDisparityPercent

formulas.description: Overstatement only. A negative disparity can never satisfy a >= comparison against a positive threshold, so understatement is never flagged.
formulas.name: fmlExceedsThreshold

Flow.label: Loan Application Financial Disparity Calc

variables.description: Intentionally left with no value. Assigning an empty Number variable is the only way to write null to a numeric field in Flow.
variables.name: varNullPercent
